Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent molecule_dictionary row filtered by chembl_id CHEMBL2403108 to get child molregnos. Join compound_structures on child molregnos. Join compound_records on child molregnos. Join docs on compound_records doc_id. Join activities on compound_records record_id. Join assays on activities assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays tid. Filter for parent compound CHEMBL2403108 and include all related salts via hierarchy. Filter activities for standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Filter assays for target CHEMBL4247.
